fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is already falsified by its own hostile criterion. Every matching has zero collision-forest coordinates, so any illegal odd XOR of legal lifted witnesses also has zero forest shell by linearity; all-eight and holonomy supply exactly such witnesses.

Proposal 3 does not define an executable fold: the quotient maps, their binary coordinates, multiplicities, and canonical tie-breaking are unspecified. Matroid rank visibility also gives no Hamming-support bound, the same rank-versus-support gap exposed by prior condensers.

Proposal 4 cannot yield polynomial separation. Weighted linear parity cost is subadditive, so an illegal XOR of three cheap legal witnesses costs at most their summed cost; the proposed LP can only optimize a finite constant and repeats the killed linear-feature lineage.

Proposal 5 lacks a polynomial-time explicit generator for the span of nonlinear root-polynomial lifts. Enumerating lifted fiber points can encode the source problem, listing logarithmic-degree monomials can be superpolynomial, and circuit realization re-enters the tableau/exact-fiber obstructions; affine sums of cheap legal lifts additionally cap separation.

Proposal 6 has no binary matrix, fixed target, or linear metric realization of filling area. Linear boundary variables abelianize the words, while explicit transition/diagram tableaus re-enter the marginal and bounded-fan-in obstructions; three cheap legal fillings can also be superposed or spliced at constant-factor cost.

Proposal 2 remains only a finite candidate, not an asymptotic mechanism. Quasirandomness controls Fourier or rank behavior rather than binary Hamming support, and the supplied p=3 test cannot establish polynomial-rank construction or all-mixed-word asymptotic soundness.
evidence: The Schur-walk verifier found all-eight and holonomy illegal mixed words of costs 6 and 9 with every added walk feature canceled. This directly defeats Proposal 1's promised hostile-family behavior and warns against Proposal 5.

The exchange-quotient verifier found 32 instances where illegal covers lie in the affine span of perfect matchings, including weight 5 versus matching weight 3. Any linear shell aggregating all legal lifts inherits these odd-superposition attacks.

The prior F8 dense condenser preserved nonzeroness but had worst YES 31 versus best NO 6; the M3(F4) fold and polar shortening produced pointed kernels. These results show that rank, noncommutativity, or dense global mixing alone does not imply Hamming soundness for Proposal 2 or 3.

The exhaustive feature-shell experiment achieved at best 7/6, below the base 5/3, and hashes frequently made NO cheaper than YES. Proposal 4 offers a larger finite LP over the same linear-cost mechanism, not an escape.

No supplied verifier implements any of the six current proposals. Consequently none of their claimed experimental gains is existing evidence, and any successful tiny run must remain explicitly finite.
next_experiment: Test only Proposal 2 in one frozen form: represent PSL2(F3)≅A4 concretely, order its 12 elements lexicographically, label the canonically sorted eight triple coordinates by the first eight elements, and use the lexicographically first representative of each of the four conjugacy classes as probes. Build the exact binary fold, enumerate every mixed word on the existing YES/NO, affine-closure, all-eight, and holonomy suite, and attack all 8! label permutations. Kill unless there are no pointed kernels, best NO exceeds worst YES, every hostile semantic illegal word exceeds its instance's legal pure-square baseline, and the exact-rank exponent exceeds the unfurled 0.2447428; a pass is finite evidence only.
